description: Unofficial Spamton G. Spamton fan-art companion inspired by Deltarune, independently drawn as the small Chapter 2 salesman puppet. His physical-right lens is pink and physical-left lens yellow; the short black jacket has a white V-shaped chest and no tie. Original harmless routines include a star-token reveal, presenter flourish, blank-card correction, paper stacking, a small jump and three-direction puppet scurrying. Front landmarks were checked against an official plush; motion, back details and proportions are artistic adaptations. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
